WHEREAS
(A) The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled as “ZAMEEN PHOENIX”,
comprising of inter alia residential apartments, penthouse, and commercial shops located at Plot No.
133, Shadman, Lahore (“Project”);
(B) The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and is desirous to purchase the
penthouse(s)/apartment(s)/shop(s) as described in Description of Purchased Unit (“Purchased
Unit”); and
(C) The Developer has agreed to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this
Agreement to Sell.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions:
SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION
1. For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation
the full Purchase Price, the Developer will sell the rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in
accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached
hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or
entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint
and several.
2. The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive
agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of
which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement”):
(i)
(ii)
(iii)
(iv)
(v)
(vi)
(vii)

This Agreement to Sell;
Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit & Nominees Form;
Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions;
Appendix A: Payment Plan;
Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan;
Appendix C: List of Materials; and
Any other document incorporated by reference in this Agreement.

3. The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event
of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the
General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit. Any
terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and
Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all
documents forming the Agreement.

BUYER’S WARRANTIES
4. The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times
and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer.
5. The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true
and correct in all respects.
6. The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such
Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the
obligations hereunder.
ARBITRATION
7.

Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of
whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer
that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with
the General Terms and Conditions.

SCHEDULE B
GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS
1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
1.1. Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below:
Agreement

means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions
as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell.

Agreement to Sell

means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the
Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended.

Adjusted Amount

has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General Terms and
Conditions.

Buyer

means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell
and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors,
permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one
Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally.

Common Areas

means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any
Purchased Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or
owners of all Purchased Units, including inter alia all open areas, elevators,
administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Space and
hallways.

Common Facilities

means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power
backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and
common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all
occupants and owners of Purchased Units and do not form part of any given
Purchased Unit.

Competent Authority

means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority,
department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other
authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the
Agreement.

Completion
or means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date
Estimated Completion or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of
Date
possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her
obligations inter alia as per Clauses 3 (Payment) and 5 (Construction and
Possession of Purchased Unit) of these General Terms and Conditions.
Completion Notice

____________________
Buyer’s initials

means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating
the Completion Date.
____________________
Joint Buyer’s initials

____________________

Component Materials

means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for
construction and finishing of the Project.

Developer

means ZAMEEN OMEGA (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED with its office at Pearl
One, 94 B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore.

Down Payment

means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as
given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties
in writing.

Due Date

means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments
mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the
Developer’s designated bank account.

Event of Force Majeure

has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 14.1 of these General Terms and
Conditions.

Furnishings

means the furniture items listed in Table C of Appendix C.

Instalment Payment

means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as
per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may,
subject to Clause 3.3, include any applicable Adjusted Amount.

Management Company

means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its
affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective
successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of
maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including,
inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities.

Nominee

means such person, as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who
may facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer,
under the Agreement to Sell, to Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of
the Buyer.

Parking Space

means the parking space allocated for the exclusive use of the Buyer or
occupants of the Purchased Unit.

Party

means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both.

Payment Plan

means the Payment Plan in Appendix A of the Agreement to Sell, setting out
the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase
Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer.
